ssh-brute-force.display_name: SSH: many failed password logins to one server
ssh-brute-force.description: Ten or more failed SSH password logins to one server from one address in 10 minutes. Expected only while password logins are still on; milestone 3 turns them off.

ssh-root-login.display_name: SSH: someone logged in as root
ssh-root-login.description: A successful SSH login as root. Root logins should be off after milestone 3, so one getting through needs a look.

windows-failed-logons.display_name: Windows: many failed logins for one account
windows-failed-logons.description: Ten or more failed logins (event 4625) for one account on one server in 10 minutes.

windows-new-local-admin.display_name: Windows: account added to local Administrators
windows-new-local-admin.description: An account was added to a server's local Administrators group (event 4732). Fine if it was a planned change; worth asking about if nobody planned one.
